name: verdict-devnet
notes: CONTRACTS §12.5. Create with the QuickNode Streams API (POST https://api.quicknode.com/streams/rest/v1/streams) after replacing ${API} and ${QUICKNODE_SECRET} and setting filter_function to base64(filter.js).

The webhook verifies x-qn-nonce / x-qn-timestamp / x-qn-signature = hex(HMAC_SHA256(QUICKNODE_SECRET, nonce || timestamp || raw_body)) with |now - timestamp| <= 300 s (packages/backend/src/chain/quicknode.ts).
VERDICT_PROGRAM_ID is a constant at the top of filter.js; change it together with VERDICT_PROGRAM_ID in .env.
